description: Subqueries used as EXPRESSIONS. The EXISTS half: non-correlated EXISTS over a non-empty and an empty table, both negated, EXISTS with a condition that matches and one that does not, and EXISTS beside another predicate. The SCALAR half: a constant subquery in arithmetic, an aggregate subquery in a comparison, MAX in an equality, an aggregate over an EMPTY table answering NULL, a subquery used as the whole comparison, one and then several in the SELECT list, and one in the SELECT list evaluated for every row. The CORRELATED half: a correlated COUNT and a correlated SUM in the SELECT list (including the customer with no orders, whose COUNT is 0 while its SUM is NULL), correlated EXISTS and NOT EXISTS, a correlated EXISTS on the employee-department relationship, one with two correlated conditions, one with an inequality, and a FOUR-level nested chain where only the row with a complete path through all four tables survives. Converted 1:1 from query/SubqueryExpressionsTest (now retired); the Java asserted row COUNTS almost throughout and read cells by column index, so each converted test pins the actual rows.
